name: execution-remote
title: Remote sandbox: your agent's files and shell in a sandbox on another machine (execution-serve)
description: The agent's files and a real shell in a sandbox of a host running execution-serve, over HTTP: one sandbox per conversation and agent, from a server or a Cloudflare Durable Object.

environment.name: PIKIT_SANDBOX_TOKEN
environment.description: The sandbox host's token, the same value as the host's (execution-serve); at least 32 characters (for example `openssl rand -hex 32`). Sent only to `endpoint`; never reaches a sandbox.
